title: The Night Forest Awakens
subtitle: A first Heartlight adventure
synopsis: The Little Tomorrow Crew finds a dim lantern path in the Night Forest. Together you learn what a Heartlight really is — not a pet, not a separate creature, but the glowing essence of who each Lumming is — and you take your first safe steps of Growing Together.

nodes.title: Soft glow between the mushrooms
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body:
Fireflies drift like tiny punctuation marks. Five small friends stand on a wooden path: Lumo with his crystal controller, Luna with her story scarf, Sprout with an acorn compass, Nori with Lowbeam the lantern, and Moki bouncing on pixel toes.

A quieter light flickers ahead — a trail that forgot how to shine.

choices.label: Look carefully first (Sprout would approve)
choices.line: Look first. Pick a step. Try it together.

choices.label: Ask the crew what they notice
choices.memory: We asked the crew before deciding.

nodes.title: Traillight steps
nodes.speaker: sprout
nodes.body:
Sprout holds up the acorn compass. Traillight paints soft leaf-shaped markers on the path.

“See? Three safe steps. The middle one is a little wobbly — that’s okay if we go slow. Rushing is how fireflies bump their noses.”

choices.label: Take the path one step at a time
choices.memory: We walked the Night Forest path carefully with Sprout.

nodes.title: Crew circle
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body:
Lumo taps the crystal controller. Questlight sparks like a tiny constellation.

“Player one — that’s you. Crew first. We don’t split up in a dim forest. We co-op.”

Lila smiles. “Maybe the dim light is a feeling, not a monster.”
Nori whispers, “Or a question that wants quiet.”
Moki grins. “Or a plot twist with sparkles!”

choices.label: Wonder if the dim light is a feeling (with Luna)
choices.memory: We treated the dim light like a feeling, not a foe.

choices.label: Approach quietly with Nori
choices.memory: We practiced quiet noticing with Nori.

choices.label: Let Moki make the fear smaller with a kind joke
choices.memory: Moki helped us laugh the wobble away — kindly.

nodes.title: Dreamlight ribbons
nodes.speaker: luna
nodes.body:
Luna’s Dreamlight unfurls violet-gold ribbons that sketch pictures in the air: a worried lantern, a child holding a friend’s hand, a heart that glows from the inside.

“A Heartlight isn’t a pet you chase,” she says softly. “It’s who we are — our essence. When it dims, we don’t scold it. We name the wonder… then find what is true.”

choices.label: Name the wonder: “The forest feels shy tonight.”
choices.memory: We named the Night Forest’s shy feeling.

nodes.title: Tidelight ripples
nodes.speaker: nori
nodes.body:
Nori lifts Lowbeam. Tidelight makes quiet ripples on the wood. Tiny details appear: a snail trail, a soft moth, a single bead of dew.

“Big bright is not the only brave,” Nori murmurs. “Little true is brave too. Pause. Notice. Wonder together.”

choices.label: Notice the dew and keep going gently
choices.memory: We found bravery in a single bead of dew.

nodes.title: Sparklight puzzle
nodes.speaker: moki
nodes.body:
Moki’s Sparklight scatters rose pixels that rearrange into a silly face, then a clear arrow.

“Plot twist! The dark wasn’t mean — it was just confused. Like socks in the wrong drawer. Spot the mix-up. Check it kindly. Try a new idea.”

choices.label: Check the mix-up kindly and follow the arrow
choices.memory: We untangled a mix-up without mean jokes.

nodes.title: The dim lantern
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body:
At the bend stands an old garden lantern. Its glass is dusty, not broken. Inside, a soft light flutters — not a creature trapped… a reminder of every Heartlight that has ever needed care.

Lumo looks at you. “Sometimes lights need a friend more than a fix.”

choices.label: Offer a gentle Care Ritual — wipe the glass, share warmth
choices.memory: We cared for the dim lantern like a friend.

choices.label: If it felt unsafe in real life, we’d tell a trusted adult
choices.memory: We remembered: real-world worries → trusted adult.

nodes.title: What a Heartlight is
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body:
The lantern brightens. Five Heartlights answer — Questlight, Dreamlight, Traillight, Tidelight, Sparklight — each a different colour of the same truth.

“These aren’t separate critters floating beside us,” Lumo says. “They’re our essence. Our soul-signal. Who we are when we grow with you.”

Lila adds, “When you care for us, you don’t feed a pet-light. You practice friendship.”
Pip: “Step by step.”
Nori: “Quietly true.”
Moki: “With excellent plot twists.”

choices.label: Promise to grow together — Safety First, always
choices.memory: We promised Safety First and Growing Together.

choices.label: Ask one more wonder-question before the end
choices.memory: We left the forest with a new wonder still glowing.

nodes.title: Growing Together
nodes.speaker: luna
nodes.body:
Dreamlight ribbons weave a soft circle around the crew and you.

“Tonight the Night Forest learned your footsteps,” Luna says. “Tomorrow we can I-lumming-Nate something new — a feeling, a puzzle, a joke, a path.”

The lantern stays lit. So do you.

Little lights. Big little adventures. Lifelong bonds.

nodes.title: A wonder left glowing
nodes.speaker: nori
nodes.body:
Nori cups Lowbeam. Tidelight holds one last question like dew:

“What will we notice tomorrow that we rushed past today?”

Nobody answers yet. That’s the point. The forest listens. The crew walks you home, Heartlights humming like a quiet song.

Come back for Care. Come back for the next path. We’ll be here — essence shining, Safety First.
